instruction.text: How many centimetres make one metre? Choose the correct answer on the right side.

end.text: Well done. 1`m` is the same length as 100`cm`. This means that 1`m` is one hundred times longer than 1`cm`.
end.sound: Well done. 1 metre is the same length as 100 cm. This means that 1 metre is one hundred times longer than 1 cm.

hint.sound: 1 metre is the same length as 100 cm.

atoms.b: To convert a length given in metres to centimetres, the measurement needs to be multiplied by ((1 10 ++100)).

instruction.text: The height of a pear tree is 6 metres. How tall is the tree in centimetres? Choose the correct answer.

atoms.sound: 6 metres is the same length as 600 cm.

instruction.text: The length of a bus is 18 metres. How long is the bus in centimetres? Choose the correct answer.

atoms.sound: 18 metres is the same length as 1800 cm.

instruction.text: The height of a house is 28 metres. How tall is the house in centimetres? Choose the correct answer.

atoms.sound: 28 metres is the same length as 2800 cm.

instruction.text: The height of a waterfall is 3 metres. How tall is the waterfall in centimetres? Choose the correct answer.

atoms.sound: 3 metres is the same length as 300 cm.
